findings.title: Secret in hardcoded local value
findings.description: A Terraform local with a secret-like name (password, secret, token) and a hardcoded string value bakes the credential into version control and state. Reference a secrets manager instead. The secret value is never included in findings.
findings.remediation: Remove the hardcoded secret immediately and rotate it. Store secrets in AWS Secrets Manager or SSM Parameter Store (SecureString) and reference them via data sources. Never commit secrets to version control — scan history with gitleaks if the value was ever committed.
